goal: Forward deployed engineer ready by April 2027

phases.title: System design foundations
phases.gate: Whiteboard 6 classic designs end to end, 45 minutes each, and publish a write-up of the best one.

weeks.title: Estimation, networking and load balancing
tasks: Latency numbers and 3 back-of-envelope estimates (QPS, storage, bandwidth)
Read DDIA chapter 1: reliability, scalability, maintainability
DNS, L4 vs L7 load balancing, health checks
Reverse proxies, API gateways and CDNs
Vertical vs horizontal scaling for a service you know
weeks.challenge: Draw the full request path for loading a product page, from DNS to database, with rough numbers at each hop.

weeks.title: Caching and storage engines
tasks: Cache-aside, write-through, write-back; LRU, LFU, TTL
Cache stampede and hot keys
DDIA chapters 2 and 3: data models, B-trees vs LSM trees
How indexes work and what they cost on writes
Pick the right database for 5 example workloads
weeks.challenge: Build a tiny LRU cache with TTL in your main language, with tests.

weeks.title: Replication and partitioning
tasks: DDIA chapter 5: leader-follower, multi-leader, leaderless
Replication lag, read-your-writes, quorums
DDIA chapter 6: partitioning by range vs hash
Consistent hashing and virtual nodes
Rebalancing and hot partitions
weeks.challenge: Implement consistent hashing with virtual nodes and measure key movement when adding a node.

weeks.title: Transactions and consensus
tasks: DDIA chapter 7: isolation levels and their anomalies
Optimistic vs pessimistic locking; 2PC and sagas
CAP and PACELC without the myths
Raft: leader election and log replication (raft.github.io)
Distributed locks and fencing tokens (Kleppmann)
weeks.challenge: Design the money transfer flow for a wallet app using a saga, including failure handling.

weeks.title: Messaging, APIs and rate limiting
tasks: Queues vs logs: SQS vs Kafka; delivery semantics
Idempotency keys, outbox pattern, dead letter queues
REST vs gRPC, pagination, versioning
Rate limiting: token bucket and sliding window
OAuth 2.0 and JWTs
weeks.challenge: Implement a sliding-window rate limiter backed by Redis.

weeks.title: Reliability and observability
tasks: SLIs, SLOs and error budgets (Google SRE book)
Metrics, logs and traces, and what each answers
Timeouts, retries with jitter, circuit breakers
Graceful degradation and load shedding
Read a public postmortem and summarize the root cause
weeks.challenge: Write an SLO doc for a service you've worked on, with alerts and an error budget policy.

weeks.title: Design practice and phase review
tasks: Design a URL shortener
Design a news feed
Design a chat system
Design a payment system
Design a distributed rate limiter
weeks.challenge: Phase capstone: record one design in 45 minutes, then publish your best design as a write-up with diagrams.

phases.title: LLM application engineering
phases.gate: Ship a RAG app with an eval suite and a written cost and latency model.

weeks.title: How LLMs work and the Claude API
tasks: Tokens, context windows and sampling
The Illustrated Transformer (Jay Alammar)
Messages API, system prompts, multi-turn and streaming
Errors, retries and rate limits
Make your first 10 calls with the SDK
weeks.challenge: Build a CLI that summarizes any URL using the Claude API, with streaming output.

weeks.title: Prompting, tool use and structured output
tasks: Read Anthropic's prompt engineering guide end to end
Structure prompts with XML tags and examples
Tool use: defining tools and handling tool calls
Structured output with JSON schemas
Designing tools an LLM can use well
weeks.challenge: Build a small assistant that can call 3 tools, and improve its prompt measured on 20 inputs.

weeks.title: Embeddings and RAG
tasks: What embeddings capture and where they fail
pgvector, HNSW and similarity search
Chunking strategies
Hybrid search (BM25 plus vectors) and reranking
Anthropic's Contextual Retrieval post
weeks.challenge: Index 1,000 documents in pgvector and build a hybrid search endpoint with reranking.

weeks.title: Evals
tasks: Hamel Husain: 'Your AI product needs evals'
Build a golden dataset of 50 examples
Code-based checks vs LLM-as-judge
Error analysis: read 100 traces and cluster failure modes
Run evals in CI
weeks.challenge: Write an eval suite for your RAG app and fix the top failure mode it finds.

weeks.title: Cost, latency and documents
tasks: Prompt caching and when it pays off
Batch processing and model routing
Measuring time to first token and total latency
PDF and image input, document extraction
Citations
weeks.challenge: Cut your app's cost per query by 50% without dropping eval scores. Document how.

weeks.title: Build: RAG app over real documents
tasks: Pick a real document set (docs of a product you use)
Ingestion pipeline
Query API plus a minimal UI
Wire evals into CI and add tracing
Deploy it
weeks.challenge: Get one other person to use it and collect their feedback.

weeks.title: Ship and write the case study
tasks: Write the cost model per 1,000 queries
Write 'how this scales to 1M queries a day'
Demo video and README
Case study: problem, approach, results, tradeoffs
Review weak spots from the phase
weeks.challenge: Phase capstone: publish the case study and share it on LinkedIn.

phases.title: Agents and production AI
phases.gate: An agent that integrates with a real third-party system, deployed, monitored and evaluated.

weeks.title: Agents and workflow patterns
tasks: Anthropic: Building effective agents
Workflows vs agents, and when not to build an agent
Prompt chaining, routing and parallelization
Orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer
Lilian Weng: LLM Powered Autonomous Agents
weeks.challenge: Write an agent loop from scratch in under 150 lines, no framework.

weeks.title: MCP and the Claude Agent SDK
tasks: MCP concepts: tools, resources, prompts
Build an MCP server for an API you use
Claude Agent SDK quickstart
Subagents, hooks and permissions
Headless runs in CI
weeks.challenge: Publish an MCP server on GitHub for a service with no official one.

weeks.title: Context, memory and security
tasks: Anthropic: Effective context engineering for AI agents
Compaction and long-term memory designs
Prompt injection and the lethal trifecta (Simon Willison)
Data boundaries, PII and least privilege
Input and output guardrails
weeks.challenge: Red-team your own agent: find 3 injection paths and fix them.

weeks.title: Observability, deployment and enterprise cloud
tasks: Tracing agents with OpenTelemetry or Langfuse
Queues and workers for long-running agents
IAM, VPC and private networking basics
Claude on AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud
OAuth flows and webhooks for SaaS APIs
weeks.challenge: Deploy your agent behind a queue with full tracing and a cost, latency and success dashboard.

weeks.title: Build: integration agent
tasks: Pick a real workflow (support triage, sales research, ops reporting)
Design the system and the evals first
Build the core loop
Integrate a real SaaS tool (Slack, Jira or Notion)
Human approval steps and guardrails
weeks.challenge: Demo it end to end to someone non-technical.

weeks.title: Harden, measure and write up
tasks: Eval suite for the agent
Run it on 100 real tasks and report the success rate honestly
Monitoring and alerts
Demo video
Case study write-up
weeks.challenge: Phase capstone: publish the agent case study.

phases.title: The forward deployed role
phases.gate: Two customer-style case studies on this site and 10 applications out.

weeks.title: What FDEs do, and customer discovery
tasks: Read 10 FDE job descriptions (Anthropic, OpenAI, Palantir, Scale, startups)
Palantir's 'Dev versus Delta' post
Rate yourself on the skills that repeat
Asking good discovery questions and mapping a workflow
Interview a friend about a painful workflow at their job
weeks.challenge: Write your 'why FDE' story in 200 words.

weeks.title: Scoping, design docs and demos
tasks: Pilot vs production: what to promise
Write a 2-page pilot proposal with milestones and risks
Write a solution design doc for engineers and executives
Structure a 10-minute demo
Handling security review questions
weeks.challenge: Record a 10-minute demo of your phase 3 agent for a pretend customer.

weeks.title: Case study 1
tasks: Pick an industry (insurance claims, legal intake, logistics)
Research their workflows and data
Design the solution and its evals
Build the prototype
Measure impact and write it up
weeks.challenge: Publish case study 1.

weeks.title: Case study 2
tasks: Pick a different industry
Research workflows
Design the solution and its evals
Build the prototype
Measure impact and write it up
weeks.challenge: Publish case study 2.

weeks.title: Interview prep
tasks: Design an enterprise RAG system out loud
Design an LLM gateway with routing and caching
Practical coding: build small things fast
8 STAR stories: ambiguity, conflict, customer, failure
Decomposition interviews (Palantir style)
weeks.challenge: Do 2 mock interviews with a peer.

weeks.title: Applications and retrospective
tasks: Polish resume around customer impact
Update LinkedIn and this site's portfolio
Send 10 applications
Reach out to 5 people for referrals
Write the 6-month retrospective
weeks.challenge: 10 applications sent and your retrospective published on this site.
